en.title: October 15: The 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck as the Orionid Meteor Shower Starts Building Toward Next Week's Peak
en.excerpt: The year's best-known meteor shower is quietly building toward its peak next week. Here are the three zodiac animals with the best luck for this early, easy-to-miss stretch.

fr.title: 15 octobre : les 3 signes du zodiaque chinois les plus chanceux pendant que les Orionides montent doucement vers leur pic de la semaine prochaine
